description: Desktop windows. Paperwren is a viewer: the fs plugin gets read-only access so picked files can be read. No write, no network permissions. The broad read scope is load-bearing for one feature the dialog runtime scope cannot cover: reopening a recent from a PREVIOUS session resolves a plain path with no fresh user gesture. fs:default is already read-only, so the exposure is read-only by construction; desktop builds are internal (docs/12). Folder browsing adds read-dir and stat over the same read-only scope (list a folder the user chose, show sizes and dates).
